data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Stonecradle Rejoins Fight as Weathered Expanse Strongpoints Swirl
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition the busiest action has moved on. Stonecradle, silent in the late afternoon, has re-entered the fight with three strongpoint changes in the latest two hours, six in six, and twenty-four on the day; the last change came at the cutoff. Weathered Expanse remains the most active front, with eleven changes in two hours, twenty in six, and thirty-eight in twenty-four; its nine strongpoints now stand three Warden, five Colonial, and one in no-man's-land. Godcrofts keeps burning at six changes in the latest two hours, nineteen on the day. Stlican Shelf still leads the daily tally at forty-six changes, though its latest action was near 22:10. Oarbreaker has flared into view with three changes in two hours and six on the day. LinnMercy and DeadLands, both busy earlier, have gone quiet, with no strongpoint event since 21:10 and 20:53 respectively. Callahan's Passage remains quiet on the strongpoint front despite heavy casualties.
